summary: Accendra Health (NYSE: ACH; formerly Owens & Minor) filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 announcing Kenneth Gardner-Smith, a director since March 2022, as next President and CEO, effective early Q4 2026. He succeeds Edward A. Pesicka, who previously announced retirement and will remain CEO until transition, then exit the board, serving as advisor. Gardner-Smith stays a non-independent director, leaving Audit and People/Culture committees. Compensation: $1,000,000 base salary, 130% target bonus. The board unanimously appointed him following a planned succession process, not an abrupt departure.
